# Compute song_ids to remove from (1) Spotify song library and (2) all playlists in library
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pass = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
spotify_user = 'jefsmith@gmail.com'
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_user, password=spotify_pass)['access_token']

# 1) Fetch all songs in song library (pagination)
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
library_songs = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page or len(page)==0:
        break
    library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('song library songs fetched:', len(library_songs))

# helper: parse year

def parse_year(release_date):
    if not release_date:
        return None
    s = str(release_date)
    # take first 4 digits if they look like year
    if len(s) < 4:
        return None
    try:
        return int(s[:4])
    except:
        return None

# Cache release year & title for song_ids we inspect
release_cache = {}

def get_song_release_info(song_id):
    if song_id in release_cache:
        return release_cache[song_id]
    detail = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    rd = detail.get('release_date')
    year = parse_year(rd)
    release_cache[song_id] = {
        'song_id': song_id,
        'title': detail.get('title'),
        'release_date': rd,
        'release_year': year
    }
    return release_cache[song_id]

# Compute songs to remove from song library (year > 2021)
remove_library_song_ids = []
for s in library_songs:
    info = get_song_release_info(s['song_id'])
    if info['release_year'] is not None and info['release_year'] > 2021:
        remove_library_song_ids.append(s['song_id'])

remove_library_song_ids = sorted(set(remove_library_song_ids))
print('songs to remove from song library (release_year>2021):', len(remove_library_song_ids))
print('library remove song ids:', remove_library_song_ids)
print('library remove songs details:')
for sid in remove_library_song_ids:
    info = release_cache[sid]
    print(' ', sid, info['title'], info['release_year'], info['release_date'])

# 2) Fetch all playlists in playlist library (pagination)
page_index = 0
all_playlists = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page or len(page)==0:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('playlist library playlists fetched:', len(all_playlists))

# unique song ids appearing in playlists
playlist_song_ids = set()
for pl in all_playlists:
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []) or []:
        playlist_song_ids.add(sid)

print('unique song ids in playlists:', len(playlist_song_ids))

# Compute songs to remove from playlists (release_year>2021)
remove_playlist_song_ids = []
for sid in sorted(playlist_song_ids):
    info = get_song_release_info(sid)
    if info['release_year'] is not None and info['release_year'] > 2021:
        remove_playlist_song_ids.append(sid)

remove_playlist_song_ids = sorted(set(remove_playlist_song_ids))
print('songs to remove from playlists (release_year>2021):', len(remove_playlist_song_ids))
print('playlist remove song ids:', remove_playlist_song_ids)
print('playlist remove songs details (showing up to 30):')
for sid in remove_playlist_song_ids[:30]:
    info = release_cache[sid]
    print(' ', sid, info['title'], info['release_year'], info['release_date'])

# Login and prepare playlist removal actions
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()

spotify_user = 'jefsmith@gmail.com'
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_user, password=spotify_pass)['access_token']

# Set of song_ids to remove from playlists (release_year > 2021)
remove_playlist_song_ids = {4, 8, 9, 10, 51, 56, 57, 67, 84, 87, 88, 106, 111, 144, 152, 153, 174, 207, 221, 267, 271, 288, 292, 299, 306, 322}

# Fetch all playlists in library (pagination)
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page or len(page)==0:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total playlists:', len(all_playlists))

# Build (playlist_id, song_id) actions by intersecting with remove set
actions = []
for pl in all_playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    sids = pl.get('song_ids') or []
    for sid in sids:
        if sid in remove_playlist_song_ids:
            actions.append((pl_id, sid))

print('total playlist song removals (occurrences):', len(actions))
# show per playlist counts
from collections import defaultdict
per_pl = defaultdict(int)
for pl_id, sid in actions:
    per_pl[pl_id]+=1
